players.bio: Adrian Miles Heris F. Stennett-Blake (born 15 July 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Dutch Eredivisie club Utrecht. Born in Islington, Blake joined Watford in 2013. Blake made his senior Watford debut on 23 August 2022 when coming on as a second half substitute in a 2–0 home defeat to Milton Keynes Dons in the second round of the EFL Cup.

Alonzo Tim Engwanda-Ongena (born 27 January 2003) is a Belgian footballer who plays as a midfielder for FC Utrecht. Engwanda was born in Belgium to a Congolese father and Belgian mother. He played for RSCA Futures, making his debut in 2022 at the U19 level. He captained the side prior to signing for FC Utrecht in 2024, agreeing to a four-year contract.
Ángel Alarcón Galiot (born 15 May 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie club Utrecht.

Anthony Correia (born 2 May 1982) is a Dutch professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of Eredivisie club Utrecht. A right-back during his playing career, Correia spent his entire professional career with Telstar, making him a one-club man.
Artem Romanovych Stepanov (born 10 August 2007) is a Ukrainian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club Utrecht, on loan from Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.

Arthur Rene Abdel Aziz Zagré (born 4 October 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Dutch Eredivisie club Utrecht. Born in France, he plays for the Burkina Faso national team.
Dani de Wit (born 28 January 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Dutch Eredivisie club FC Utrecht.
David Min (born 23 June 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club Utrecht.

Dave Johannes Andreas van den Berg (born 4 February 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for FC Utrecht. Club career Early years Van den Berg played youth football for his hometown club UDI '19, before joining the PSV Eindhoven youth academy in 2008.
Ferdinand Pohl is a 19-year-old German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Dutch club FC Utrecht. Born on February 2, 2007, he is widely regarded as a rising defensive talent.

Guus Offerhaus is a 25-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club FC Utrecht. He recently moved to the club on a free transfer from SC Telstar in the summer of 2026, signing a three-year contract that runs until June 2029.
Jakov Medić is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie club FC Utrecht, on loan from EFL Championship club Norwich City.

Jamie Schuldes is a 19-year-old German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Dutch club FC Utrecht. Standing at an impressive 1.93 metres (6'4") tall, he is known for his dominant physical presence in defense. He also represents Germany internationally at the U19 youth level.
Joris van Overeem (born 1 June 1994) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Utrecht.

Kevin Gadellaa is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Eredivisie club FC Utrecht and its reserve team, Jong FC Utrecht. He is widely recognized in the football world for his extraordinary height, standing at 2.10 metres (6 feet 11 inches) tall, making him one of the tallest professional football players in the world.

Kevin Alexander Paredes (born May 7, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a left wing-back or left winger for Dutch Eredivisie club Utrecht and the United States national team.
Marius Sivertsen Broholm (born 26 December 2004) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lille.
Matisse Didden (born 8 October 2001) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie club Utrecht.
Michael Brouwer (born 21 January 1993) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Sparta.

Mike Eerdhuijzen (born 13 July 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre back for FC Utrecht. Club career Eerdhuijzen played in the youth department of FC Volendam until 2018, where he signed a contract until 2022. From 2017, he began playing for Jong FC Volendam in the Derde Divisie.
Miliano Jonathans (born 5 April 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Eredivisie club Utrecht.
Neville Ogidi Nwankwo (born 8 October 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie club Utrecht.
Nigel Ogidi Nwankwo (born 4 August 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eredivisie club Telstar.
Niklas Vesterlund (born 6 June 1999) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a right back for Dutch Eredivisie club Utrecht.
Nikolas Panayiotou (Greek: Νικόλας Παναγιώτου; born 12 May 2000) is a Cypriot footballer who plays for Omonia as a midfielder.

Noah Chidiebere Junior Anyanwu Ohio is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club Utrecht. Club career Born in the Netherlands, Ohio joined Manchester United in 2015 before joining Manchester City the following year. In June 2019, he agreed to join the youth academy of Bundesliga side RB Leipzig.

Noureddine "Nordin" Amrabat (Arabic: نورالدين أمرابط, Berber languages: ⵏⵓⵓⵔⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⴰⵎⵔⴰⴱⴰⵜ; born 31 March 1987) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Moroccan Botola Pro club Wydad. Amrabat played for Morocco, which he represented at two Africa Cup of Nations tournaments, 2012 Olympics, and 2018 FIFA World Cup.
Oualid Agougil (born 7 August 2005) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defender for Jong Utrecht. He committed to play for the Morocco national team.

Sergio Vincenzo Roberto Padt (born 6 June 1990) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ludogorets Razgrad. Padt previously played on loan from AFC Ajax for HFC Haarlem in the Eerste Divisie, and later for Go Ahead Eagles and in the Belgian Pro League for Gent. He represented the Netherlands U-17 team at the 2007 UEFA European Under-17 Football Championship.
Siebe Horemans (born 2 June 1998) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Eredivisie club Utrecht.

Vasilis Cornelius Barkas (Greek: Βασίλης Μπάρκας; born 30 May 1994) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Utrecht and the Greece national team. Barkas was born in Athens to a Greek father and Dutch mother. Barkas played for Greece at under-19 and under-21 level, making six appearances for the U19s and eight for the U21s.
Victor Christoffer Jensen (born 8 February 2000) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Eredivisie club Utrecht.
Yoann Cathline (born 22 July 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Dutch Eredivisie club Utrecht
